description_en: Adds an HTTPS application configuration to a site
name: CreateHttpsApplicationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Site. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The Site's configuration Version. For Sites with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the Version to which the configuration applies. The default is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The name of the Rule. This parameter is optional when adding a Global Configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is optional when adding a Global Configuration. Valid values:

`on`: The rule is enabled.

`off`: The rule is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The content of the Rule, which is a Conditional Expression that matches user Requests. This parameter is optional when adding a Global Configuration. Supported use cases include:

To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

To match specific requests, use a custom expression. For example: `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Force HTTPS. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_force

parameters.help_en:
The Redirection Status Code to use when Force HTTPS is enabled. Valid values:

`301`

`302`

`307`

`308`
parameters.help_zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：
301
302
307
308
parameters.name: https_force_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Alt-Svc header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the `clear` parameter in the Alt-Svc header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: The parameter is included.

`off`: The parameter is not included
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc_clear

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the `persist` parameter in the Alt-Svc header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: The parameter is included.

`off`: The parameter is not included
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc_persist

parameters.help_en: The Max Age for the Alt-Svc header, in seconds. The default is 86400
parameters.help_zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒
parameters.name: alt_svc_ma

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS). Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts

parameters.help_en: The value of the `max-age` directive for the HSTS header, in seconds
parameters.name: hsts_max_age

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the `includeSubDomains` directive in the HSTS header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: The directive is included.

`off`: The directive is not included
parameters.help_zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts_include_subdomains

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS Preload by including the `preload` directive in the HSTS header. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: The directive is included.

`off`: The directive is not included
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts_preload

parameters.help_en: The execution order of the rule. A lower value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI) verification. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_sni_verify

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to reject TLS Handshake Requests that do not include an SNI. Disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Rejects requests without an SNI.

`off`: Allows requests without an SNI
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_no_sni_deny

parameters.help_en: Specifies the allowlist of SNI values. Separate multiple values with a space
parameters.help_zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔
parameters.name: https_sni_whitelist
